\subsection{C1: decoder states, controls and robustness}
\label{sec:c1-app}

Table~\ref{tab:c1-e3} gives E3 for every arm (\S\ref{sec:c1-e3}), Table~\ref{tab:c1-t8} the T8
controls (\S\ref{sec:c1-t8}) and Table~\ref{tab:c1-sens} the robustness runs
(\S\ref{sec:c1-robust}). Tables~\ref{tab:c1-gamma} and~\ref{tab:c1-shared} give
$\gamma_2,\gamma_3,\gamma_4$ of Eq.~\ref{eq:eqthree} and the shared-error check of
Proposition~\ref{prop:select} (\S\ref{sec:c1-beta}, \S\ref{sec:c1-main}).
